hooks.name: Safety review for sandbox and API edits
hooks.description: When code that runs untrusted packages or guards the API is saved, re-check the safety invariants.

action.prompt: The file just saved runs untrusted package code or guards the API that triggers it. Before continuing, check the change against .kiro/steering/sandbox-safety.md: untrusted values must not reach code or a shell, dependencies must stay plain wheel-only requirements, paths must stay contained, the environment must stay scrubbed, every step needs a timeout that kills the process tree, CORS must not widen, and a run on the wrong Python must never read as success. If any invariant was weakened, say which one and restore it, and make sure a test covers it. If none changed, say so in one line.
